title: 1.1 Information Technology as a Career
description: IT job roles, skills, demand and growth

questions.question: What does ICT stand for?
ICT refers to the convergence of which three areas?
What do IT professionals use their technical skills and knowledge to do?
options: Design, develop, implement, and manage technology solutions
questions.correctAnswer: Design, develop, implement, and manage technology solutions

questions.question: Which IT job role provides technical assistance and support to users?
Which IT job role designs, implements, and maintains computer networks?
Which IT job role manages and maintains computer systems and servers?
Which IT job role designs and develops software applications?
Which IT job role analyzes and interprets data to derive insights?
Which IT job role protects computer systems and networks from security threats?
Which IT job role plans, executes, and manages technology projects?
Which of the following is listed as an essential IT skill?
options: Proficiency in programming languages and software development
questions.correctAnswer: Proficiency in programming languages and software development

questions.question: An essential IT skill set includes knowledge of which of the following?
options: Computer networks, hardware, and operating systems
questions.correctAnswer: Computer networks, hardware, and operating systems

questions.question: Which essential IT skill area covers understanding of databases and data management?
Which essential IT skill helps professionals work effectively with others?
Why is continuous learning essential for IT professionals?
options: Because IT jobs require no prior skills
Because it is required only once after graduation
Because the field is constantly evolving with new technologies
questions.correctAnswer: Because the field is constantly evolving with new technologies

questions.question: Which set of industries is named in the module as relying on IT?
options: Healthcare, finance, education, entertainment, and manufacturing
questions.correctAnswer: Healthcare, finance, education, entertainment, and manufacturing

questions.question: How can IT professionals advance their careers according to the module?
options: By working only with old hardware
By gaining experience, acquiring certifications, and continuously updating their skills
questions.correctAnswer: By gaining experience, acquiring certifications, and continuously updating their skills

questions.question: Into which specialized areas can IT professionals move?
How can continuous learning be achieved in IT?
options: Through self-study, workshops, certifications, or higher education
Only by reading one book once
Only by attending a single training day
questions.correctAnswer: Through self-study, workshops, certifications, or higher education

questions.question: Which of the following describes the impact of IT on society?
options: It reduced communication to local areas only
It removed all forms of electronic communication
It revolutionized communication, improved access to information, transformed business processes, and facilitated global connectivity
questions.correctAnswer: It revolutionized communication, improved access to information, transformed business processes, and facilitated global connectivity
